source_status_rule: white-paper concept != DevelopmentGuide proposal != public draft schema != ratified specification != implementation != conformance evidence
research_correction: The reviewed public Development Guide explicitly defines Assurance and Validation Flows, Viability Envelopes, Coordination Envelopes, federation origin/recognition concepts, FRS evidence references/confidence, and non-executive recommendations. Therefore these are not treated as absent architecture. The remaining engineering opportunity is executable, provenance-preserving, adversarially testable, formally refinable, and runtime-portable realization.

dimensions.source_basis: Public architecture names provenance proofs and evidence references, but a single ratified cross-system evidence-envelope schema is not present in the reviewed draft.
Versioning, lineage, persistence, thresholds, and reliability histories are described, but a universal validity-window contract is not ratified in the reviewed material.
FRS exposes confidence and evidence references; a universal cross-system conflict-state algebra is not ratified in the reviewed material.
System boundaries and non-executive recommendation semantics are explicit, while a universal claim-ceiling field is not identified in the reviewed draft.
FRS findings and recommendations are distinct from source-system data; a universal transition algebra remains a candidate engineering layer.
Production Mandate is explicitly a CDS decision authorizing COS production; FRS recommendations are explicitly non-executive.
Capability/capacity flows and production coordination are described, but a universal qualification-vs-current-availability algebra is not ratified.
Public architecture explicitly models dependency-linked production domains and dependency stress; lifecycle/maintainability and replacement semantics are described in OAD/COS materials.
OAD maintains design lineage history; FRS is designed to learn from operational feedback and reliability histories.
Federation architecture distinguishes autonomous nodes and Assurance/Validation Flows; cryptographic integrity and universal recognition rules remain implementation/deferred details.
Reviewed public draft names verification/oracle concerns but does not provide a ratified formal-proof/refinement/receipt contract.
FRS performs diagnostic/forecasting-style analytical work, while recommendations remain non-executive; explicit observation-predicate exclusion for predictions is a candidate engineering refinement.
Public research discusses bounded emergency protocols and coordination envelopes; exact emergency authorization contract remains unresolved in the reviewed draft.
OAD lineage and FRS feedback/review are explicit; a universal correction/supersession protocol is not ratified.

The public guide explicitly identifies verification/oracle problems, physical triangulation, outcome-based verification, and strategic misrepresentation as design concerns; implementation remains unresolved.

claim_ceiling: Research/engineering baseline only; classifications describe the reviewed public draft and do not establish absence from the full Integral design.
